lines.text: Comm channel established. Endmin, I need some visual data.
Nevertheless, we should keep an eye on changes to Derangement levels. I also have the emergency evac program ready at all times.
Perhaps our activities in the place have exerted some influence... That is also within our expectations.
Your next objective is to eliminate the previous encountered obstacle and approach the "key target".
If the scanning data is correct, we should find an energy reaction site nearby, similar to the one we found before. Gotta find them all.
The exploration support tech should be working right now. We should be able to stay inside for a while longer.
That's it for the sitrep. Let's not waste time and begin our formal exploration efforts.

options: We got more enemies.
Hope we have enough time.
Sounds like a major undertaking.

lines.text: We finally earned a chance to scan it... Hold on. I'm organizing our data right now.
Really...? That might explain a few things. After all, you were the one who knew most about the secrets of the Protocol Space.
No, it's nothing. I'm safe, but...
Data received. We can — WAIT! What's going on?!
Something weird just happened outside. Come back quickly, Endmin. You must take a look at this.

options: This thing looks quite ... familiar to me.
I think I saw this before, but I can't really remember.
What is it?
Do we have a situation, Aquito?

lines.text: Picked up the return signal. Ambient status looks stable... Good. Adjusting device parameters did not trigger any unexpected changes.
Endmin? Did you find something?
Oh? I can't really tell from the data acquired from the basic scans.
Understood. Let's get started.

options: The ambient "vibe" just changed.
This place feels a bit more "open" now.
I should check around the place.

lines.text: Endmin ... signal ... gerous!

options: Aquito, I've scanned the Aberrant Core.
Aquito? Can you hear me?

lines.text: Comm signals are stable. Device readings are ... within tolerance limits.
Endmin?
Tremor? Data readings look normal so far, but your senses have always been valuable to us.
We should get moving. Where do you think the last Aberrant Core will be?
Understood. I'll get a special scan prepped. Please handle the obstacles along the way, Endmin.

options: Did you detect some kind of tremor?
The deepest part of this Protocol Space.
My intuition tells me we're close to the finish line.

lines.text: I'm receiving the scanning data... Did we just succeed?
Data overlapping is indeed increasing. You might be right... Hold on and let me initiate the usual executables.
Zone 1 comparative verification complete...
For this particular phase, Endmin. Data processing isn't complete yet. But I've a feeling we just took a major leap forwards with this endeavor.
Head back ASAP, Endmin. See you in realspace.
Zone 2 comparative verification complete...
Properties of Zones 3, 4, and 5 are being recorded... Good. Things are in line with my expectations.

options: There's nowhere else to go.
I defeated the "enemy" that showed up here.
Is my job done?

lines.text: Disappearance of the unknown obstacle confirmed. My hypothesis is indeed correct.
Scanning the new environment... Great. I've picked up a reading with similar signal properties some distance away.
Let's repeat the steps we used before. Try to gather as much useful data as we can.
This zone... Its ambient readings are quite different from those we detected before.
Careful. You might run into new types of enemies in this place.
I also detected the presence of strong barriers. Explosives should take care of them.
I don't think this is a coincidence. There must be some sort of link between them... Anyway, we should start exploring.
We've reached a new zone. The spatial layout is a lot more complicated. Protocol Spaces of such scale are rare indeed.
The signal of the Aberrant Core is pretty far off. We'll run into plenty of obstacles.
Like before, there's no need to completely explore everything in a single attempt. Plan your moves and progress accordingly.
We've arrived at a new zone. Hmm... Moving around this place might be a challenge.
That's right. The question is, how do we get there...?
Let's start exploring the nearby facilities. Try using the buildings and connecting the structures. Perhaps we'll come up with a proper path.

options: The Aberrant Core is over there.

lines.text: We've reached a new zone... No other connected zones have been detected.
If my calculations are correct, this should be the deepest part of the Valley's Aberrants.
I'm counting on you, Endmin. Protocol Spaces have always been veiled in mystery. We might have reached the very threshold to reveal their underlying truth.
Time to finish our final task.

options: Something imposing seems to be looming ahead...
We might be facing a terrible battle.
